verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a batch queue (with a 20% discount for batched Parse/Extract jobs) plus async job submission (run_job) and webhook-based result delivery, which together support processing many documents at once. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on batch size limits, a dedicated bulk/batch API reference, or hands-on confirmation of large-scale throughput. Missing for 10: dedicated batch API documentation with concurrency/size limits, independent evidence of successful large-batch runs.
